modeling_corrections: The printed maximization Lagrangian has positive squared penalties but Equation 8a uses arg-min. Use the standard equivalent minimization of negative generation plus positive augmented quadratics.

Printed Equation 1d remains active for an uninstalled target cell and may make it infeasible. Add the standard tight binary implication M(1-x_i), with M equal to the sum of all incoming pair losses for that target and scenario.
Projection onto the l2 sphere is set-valued at its centre. Continue along the deterministic exact-cardinality warm-start direction.
Count scenario subproblem solves and complete-layout evaluations separately; do not label mathematical-programming iterations as evolutionary FES.
completion_decisions: Reconstruct a normalized smooth Danish-sector directional prior and direction-dependent rated-region speeds; do not fit optimized table values.
Use the cited Frandsen-Gaussian equations, NREL 5 MW geometry and a disclosed cubic-to-rated power curve.
Replace unavailable Gurobi by pinned HiGHS revision 04024d701f79feb8e2f18bc3df0dffc04ef05088.

Avoid the pinned HiGHS active-set QP degeneracy failure by representing each separable x-squared term with 33 uniform epigraph tangents. The x-squared underestimation is bounded by 1/(4*32^2) on [0,1].
Use residual balancing at ratio 10 and binary-feasibility-assisted rho growth by factor 1.5 while rounding deviation exceeds 5 percent.
Use an exact-cardinality boundary-priority deterministic warm start and stable top-cardinality final rounding.
Execute one deterministic paper-native run for each of the four cases.
